ContractsMinimumVersion.description: The oldest contracts version the server still serves.

ContractsVersion.description: The newest contracts version the server serves.

The contracts version (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) the client was built against. A version outside the served range is refused with `426 contracts_version_unsupported`; one that is not a version with `400 contracts_version_malformed`. A request without it is accepted and served at the current version (ADR-0078).
ContractsVersion.name: x-agent-workspace-contracts

BadRequest.description: `contracts_version_malformed` when the `x-agent-workspace-contracts` header is not a version, refused before authentication; otherwise the route’s own validation failure.

ContractsVersionUnsupported.description: `contracts_version_unsupported`: the client’s contracts version is outside the served range, refused before authentication; the range headers say which side must upgrade.

Problem.description: The standard error envelope. Branch on `error.code`, never on `message`.

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key (`ak_live_…`) or a browser token minted by `POST /api/tokens`.

invitationCookie.description: The invitation-identity cookie OIDC sign-in sets for an invitee who has no membership yet; it carries an identity, not a workspace. A deployment that sets `AW_INSTANCE_ID` names it `__Host-aw_invitation_identity_<AW_INSTANCE_ID>`.
invitationCookie.name: __Host-aw_invitation_identity

sessionCookie.description: The control plane’s own browser session. A deployment that sets `AW_INSTANCE_ID` names it `__Host-aw_session_<AW_INSTANCE_ID>`, so two deployments on one host keep separate sessions.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-aw_session

info.description: The public `/api/**` surface of the Agent Workspace control plane, generated from `@indx-workspace/contracts` by `scripts/docs/generate-openapi.mjs`. Never edit it by hand: the Zod schemas are the source of truth. Every failure is the standard envelope `{ error: { code, message, details?, detail? } }`.

post.summary: Fire a webhook trigger: the body is the {{body}} of its prompt and a run starts as the trigger owner in a new session (202). The URL secret is the authentication and travels in the path, so it can appear in access logs of a proxy or CDN: rotate it if one may have leaked. Every miss answers one 404 trigger_not_found. A Microsoft Graph validationToken query parameter is echoed as text/plain, and Zoom endpoint.url_validation is answered with the token and its HMAC (200); neither starts a run.
